response.title: Io update 3
response.body:
The following updates were made:

- VIH/VIL input threshold parameters were fixed (CDL and layout, added 3.3V input buffer) to comply with the specification.
- Receiver (input): Delay balance was fixed (CDL and layout, added additional input stage to drive low-voltage CMOS input).
- Issue #401. The analog pad current capability was improved.
- Issue #385. M2 connections in ground pads were improved.
- Issue #419. Antenna diode structures were added to the core inputs (layout fix).
- Issue #835. The layout at the cell edges was aligned to allow abutment without DRC errors.
- Issue #676, #953. Liberty models were updated. New look-up tables with increased load ranges are used. Fillers and corner cells were added to the Liberty and Verilog models.
- Issue #909. Contacts were added to the Filler200 cell.
- The cell list was updated: sub-blocks are excluded (not library cells).
- The "sg13g2_Galery" top layout was removed from the GDS2 layout view.
- The CDL netlist was regenerated.
- The SPICE netlist was regenerated and renamed to "sg13g2_io.spice" to align its naming with the sg13g2_stdcell library.
- The pin directions in the LEF file were fixed.

The updated PR data **must be validated by other designers** using the existing flows before being merged. Depending on the results, changes to the flow settings may be required.
Please do not merge this PR if the next tape-out is imminent!
